candidates.statement: A dynamic cryptic sub-pocket (Pocket #3, 299 A^3, druggability 0.788) adjacent to the D374/F379/S381 EGF-A interface stabilizes a conformation incompatible with LDLR binding, enabling MW < 420 Da oral small molecules.
Peptidomimetic bicyclic scaffold directly competing with LDLR EGF-A residues N295-C308 on the solvent-exposed PCSK9 catalytic surface.
Heterobifunctional degrader linking a PCSK9 C-terminal domain binder to a thalidomide CRBN ligand.
